title: DGX SuperPOD - Per-Sensor Temperatures (granular /Sensors endpoint, 80s scrape)
description: Fleet-scale per-component temperature dashboard for the DGX SuperPOD cluster. Reworked for fleet-scale: high-cardinality per-sensor graphs replaced with topk(20) outlier views plus 'hottest sensor' offender tables (empty table = healthy). Sources: DCGM GPU/HBM temps, node_exporter hwmon (NIC/NVMe/ACPI) and node_thermal_zone_temp, UFM switch temps, DCGM thermal violations, and Loki over-temp events. NOTE: Redfish/BMC per-sensor temps are now LIVE via redfish_temperature_celsius (~62k sensors, 574 BMCs) and wired in the 'Redfish / BMC' row; bad-sensor sentinel readings (~8e11) are filtered with < 150.
